title: SAE Feature Stability Under Input Paraphrase

original_idea.body:
# SAE Feature Stability Under Input Paraphrase

**Problem:** Whether an interpreted SAE feature fires consistently across paraphrases of the same content versus being a surface artifact is rarely tested.

**Direction:** Take named GPT-2-small SAE features from Neuronpedia. Construct paraphrase sets and measure each feature's activation consistency (coefficient of variation). Rank features by paraphrase-robustness.

**Why it matters:** If interpretability monitors trip on surface form, an adversary paraphrases around them.

**Relevant context:** Neuronpedia hosts labeled GPT-2-small SAE features; absorption work shows many concept latents are token-aligned.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: paraphrase-fragile SAE features let adversaries evade interpretability monitors, a concrete monitoring-robustness scenario.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Use Neuronpedia features + paraphrase sets, measure activation CV; beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: feature activation consistency across paraphrases with clear metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Robustness audit of public SAE features labs deprioritize; third-party-useful.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference over public SAE; low compute.

novelty.reasoning: Systematic paraphrase-robustness audit of SAE features appears under-studied.
